description: The Reality Capture custom visual embeds 360-degree panoramas directly into Power BI. It provides a navigable, street-view style interface for monitoring site conditions and tracking spatial data without leaving the report canvas. Users can evaluate project progress over time using built-in comparison tools. Free in Power BI Desktop: Unrestricted access for local report creation and testing. A paid commercial license is required to publish, share, or view this visual in the Power BI Service. Unlicensed visuals are blocked on the web.
